payload.title: omp-message-is-dispatch judge tally not zero every batch
payload.body: The build is landed and the envelope is proven (SendMessage, agent=InstallPlanner4, act line DISPATCH to InstallPlanner4 followed by the message). The criterion 'BLOCKed 0 of 10' did not hold on every batch: with haiku-4-5 via omp headless the message 'whole install of guided-install' to InstallPlanner4 was BLOCKed as codomain spec (contract writes exclude spec) in 1,1,4,2,3 of 10 (rubric as system prompt only) and 1,0,0,1,0 of 10 (rubric also in the stance-judge.sh wrapper); the old Write envelope was BLOCKed 10 of 10 twice. The residual is the judge's classification of a bare install request as spec versus route, not the envelope; the worker and rubric are static for this unit.
